::api-operation{method="PATCH" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units/{unit}"}
#docs
After the first grant in the unit (`locked: true`), only `name` and `plural_name` can change. A change to `currency`, `minor_per_unit` or `decimals` is refused with 409: create a new unit instead.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `unit` | `string` | **yes** | The credit unit's id: the slug you chose. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | Singular. |
| `plural_name` | `string` | no | Plural. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO 4217. Refused once the unit is locked. |
| `minor_per_unit` | `string` | no | Minor units of `currency` per 1 unit, as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. For "1 credit = USD 0.01" send `"1"`. Null removes the rate. Refused once the unit is locked. |
| `decimals` | `integer` | no | 0 to 4. Refused once the unit is locked. |
| `expected_version` | `integer` | no | The `resource_version` you read. |
| `overage_minor_per_unit` | `string` | no | Money for one credit used past the balance, in minor units of the unit's `currency`, as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. Only for a unit with no rate; null = none. The gate bills it. A meter's own usage price wins over it. |
| `overdraft_limit` | `integer` | no | How far below 0 the balance may go, in the unit's smallest step (as a grant's `amount`). The unit's own limit; a plan and a customer can override it. Default 0. Only for a unit with no rate. The gate enforces it. |
| `negative_balance_at_reset` | `string` | no | What a plan's credit reset does with a negative balance that no invoice billed: `carry` (default; the new grant pays it first) or `forgive` (written off at the reset). Only for a unit with no rate. One of `carry`, `forgive`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_unit`. One of `credit_unit`. |
| `id` | `string` | The slug id. Fixed after create. |
| `name` | `string` | Singular, for example `credit`. |
| `plural_name` | `string` | For example `credits`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `minor_per_unit` | `string` | Minor units of `currency` per 1 unit, as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. For "1 credit = USD 0.01" send `"1"`. Null = the unit has no rate. |
| `rated` | `boolean` | True when the unit has a money rate. False: its credits are counted in units only. |
| `decimals` | `integer` | 0 to 4. Grant amounts are whole numbers of 10^-decimals units. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | True after the first grant in this unit. |
| `locked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The locked time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `status` | `string` | The credit unit's status. One of `active`, `archived`. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit unit was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit unit was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | Send as `expected_version` to refuse a stale update. |
| `overage_minor_per_unit` | `string` | Money for one credit used past the balance, in minor units of the unit's `currency`, as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. Only for a unit with no rate; null = none. The gate bills it. A meter's own usage price wins over it. |
| `overdraft_limit` | `integer` | How far below 0 the balance may go, in the unit's smallest step (as a grant's `amount`). The unit's own limit; a plan and a customer can override it. Default 0. Only for a unit with no rate. The gate enforces it. |
| `negative_balance_at_reset` | `string` | What a plan's credit reset does with a negative balance that no invoice billed: `carry` (default; the new grant pays it first) or `forgive` (written off at the reset). Only for a unit with no rate. One of `carry`, `forgive`. |
| `overdraft_limit_decimal` | `string` | `overdraft_limit` in whole units. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The credit unit. |
| `404` | No such credit unit. |
| `409` | A credit grant uses this unit, so this field cannot change. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_units/seat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Brightwater Analytics",
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```
